description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, the main screen of an Android TV application. It manages a complex UI that includes a top navigation bar created with Jetpack Compose, a hero carousel with auto-scrolling behavior, and several horizontally scrolling content rails such as Continue Watching and TV Channels. The fragment handles focus navigation, layout sizing with precise peeking, and integrates ViewModel data loading with appropriate UI state handling.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the home screen, managing UI layout, focus navigation, and interactions for a TV app, with a focus on a hero carousel, app bar, and content rails.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Builds the view hierarchy, sets up UI sections, and configures focus navigation.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Post-processing after view creation, including focus requests and LiveData observers.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scrolling of the hero carousel and restores focus.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling of the hero carousel.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes ViewModel LiveData for different UI states and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays an error message with an option to retry loading data.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching rail with data items.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV Channels rail with channel items.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Jetpack Compose-based top navigation bar with focus management and key handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures the hero carousel with a horizontal ScrollView, cards, auto-scrolling, and focus behavior, with precise sizing and peeking.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the hero carousel on a specific card index, with animated scrolling and peeking considerations.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses the auto-scrolling of the hero carousel temporarily after user interaction.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Starts the periodic auto-scroll of the hero carousel.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops the auto-scrolling of the hero carousel.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates the Continue Watching horizontal content rail with a title and loading indicator.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates the TV Channels content rail with title and loading indicator.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus navigation for the content rails.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels (px).
